scope: Controlled actual flight-renderer fixture; synthetic accepted defeat/surface-impact facts and 128 fixed living actors. No gameplay authority, player controls or production terrain admission. Every enabled phase begins with 1,024 destruction records and 1,024 surface-impact records, then eight mixed-material defeats plus eight impacts every two seconds. Matched phase-local movement, camera, seeds, timeline and restoration schedule. CPU covers event ingestion, actor staging and synchronous draw; GPU uses bounded asynchronous timers around the actual renderer render call, including internal passes, sampled every 15 renders. Probe overhead is included identically in both conditions; no blocking GPU readback. Not a full-app or human gameplay acceptance.
